security_audit.summary: Of 42 static findings, 41 reflect Markdown formatting, ordinary provider links, documented credential configuration, or readable multilingual text. The command block introduces supply-chain exposure by automatically executing an unpinned npm package with access to the user's environment. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional credential exfiltration in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not included.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify its provenance before execution. Require approval before downloading code, and isolate execution with only necessary credentials.

content.user_title: Research Kuaishou Topics and Video Content
content.value_statement: Content teams need traceable Kuaishou samples before choosing topics or comparing competitors. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and hot-ranking reviews with bounded collection and evidence-based summaries.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Kuaishou hot-search rankings through the documented SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tool.
Search Kuaishou video samples using a focused keyword or topic.
Bound CLI collection with page and item limits while preserving opaque continuation tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, content identifiers, links, and visible engagement data for traceable research.
Separate hot-ranking signals, keyword search evidence, and analytical judgments.
Retain partial results and resume from returned continuation tokens without exceeding original collection limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key and available service balance; CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
Provides instructions rather than a bundled data engine; the external npm package implementation is not included in this skill.
Search samples and current rankings do not establish complete platform coverage or historical trends.
Does not log in, publish content, like videos, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Choose creator topics
use_cases.description: Review current hot searches and a small keyword sample to identify content angles supported by visible evidence.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor content
use_cases.description: Collect keyword samples for competing brands and compare returned titles, authors, and visible engagement without claiming complete account coverage.

use_cases.title: Prepare an editorial brief
use_cases.description: Build a bounded sample with source links, separate observations from judgments, and preserve partial-result warnings for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Review current hot searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Kuaishou hot-search list. Summarize available rankings and heat signals. Keep observations separate from suggested content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [keyword] using one page and at most 10 items. Summarize relevant samples with available titles, authors, links, and identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: gather a small, traceable topic sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare brand samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [brand A] and [brand B] separately, using at most two pages and 20 items each. Compare visible themes and engagement. Cite available sources and coverage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare competitors using bounded keyword samples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] with current hot searches and keyword samples. Limit keyword collection to three pages and 30 items. Preserve tokens during partial recovery. Separate ranking signals, search evidence, judgments, and limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine evidence sources with bounded recovery.

output_examples.input: Show the format of a Kuaishou hot-search brief without making a live request.
output: Illustrative format only; no current ranking data was retrieved.
Ranking evidence: list each returned topic, rank, and available heat signal.
Content angles: distinguish proposed interpretations from observed rankings.
Follow-up: validate a selected topic with a bounded keyword search.

output_examples.input: Explain how a brief would report a search interrupted before its requested limit.
output: Illustrative partial-results brief; no live search was performed.
Coverage: mark the sample incomplete and retain returned items alongside the service error.
Evidence: include available titles, authors, content identifiers, links, and visible engagement.
Recovery: continue only with a returned nonempty token, reducing remaining limits by previously collected pages and items.

best_practices: Start with one page and an explicit item limit; expand collection only when the research question requires more evidence.
Preserve source identifiers and links, and distinguish observed data from interpretation and incomplete coverage.
Review and pin the external CLI package before execution; keep the API key in the environment and out of reports.
anti_patterns: Treating current hot rankings or limited search samples as complete historical trend evidence.
Rewriting pagination tokens or restarting partial searches automatically, which can duplicate results and consume service balance.
Executing unreviewed package updates or exposing API credentials in prompts, logs, or published research.

faq.question: What does this skill research?
faq.answer: It guides Kuaishou hot-search retrieval and keyword video searches, then organizes returned evidence for content planning and competitor comparisons.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure service balance. CLI use needs Node.js, npm, and network access; existing MCP tools provide another documented route.

faq.question: Does it publish or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes. External dependency behavior was not audited.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable exhaustive boundary. Use explicit page and item limits, and describe results as samples.

faq.question: What happens when a search partially fails?
faq.answer: Retain returned items and the error. Resume only with a nonempty continuation token and reduce remaining limits to avoid duplicate collection.

faq.question: How should insufficient balance be handled?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and show the provider billing link. After funding the matching account, resume under the documented partial-result recovery rules.
